details.description: Yi-Large is 01.AI's proprietary, API-only large language model, positioned as a flagship separate from the open-weight Yi and Yi-1.5 model families: unlike those, its weights are not published on 01.AI's GitHub or Hugging Face pages, and it is reachable only through 01.AI's own platform API or third-party hosts such as Fireworks AI. Fireworks AI's model listing describes it as a 70-billion-parameter dense model with a roughly 32,800-token context window that ranked among the top models on the LMSYS Chatbot Arena leaderboard at launch, close to GPT-4, Claude 3 Opus and Gemini 1.5 Pro. 01.AI's current English-language site no longer features Yi-Large and instead promotes Yi-Lightning, a newer mixture-of-experts model the company launched in October 2024.
advantages: Fireworks AI reports it ranked among the top-performing models on the LMSYS Chatbot Arena leaderboard at launch, close behind GPT-4, Claude 3 Opus and Gemini 1.5 Pro.
Fireworks AI notes strong multilingual support, calling out Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, German and French specifically.
disadvantages: 01.AI's current homepage and English-language site promote Yi-Lightning (launched October 2024) as their flagship model instead; Yi-Large is absent from 01.AI's current public pages.
Not an open-weight model: its weights are not published on 01.AI's GitHub or Hugging Face pages, unlike the rest of the Yi family.
Context window of roughly 32,800 tokens (per Fireworks AI) is far smaller than 01.AI's separate 200K-token Yi-34B-200K open release.

sources.title: 01-ai/Yi: A series of large language models trained from scratch by developers @01-ai

notes: 01.AI's own product/docs site (platform.01.ai) is JavaScript-rendered and returned no readable model content to this session, and no accessible 01.AI blog post or press release announcing Yi-Large could be opened (a PR Newswire mirror returned 404, a BusinessWire mirror returned 403); search engines were also unavailable (WebSearch quota exhausted for this session, and Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo blocked automated queries). The parameter count (70B dense), context length and language list are Fireworks AI's characterization as a host, not confirmed directly on an 01.AI page, so languages is left empty per the chat-model rule requiring the maker to state them; the multilingual claim is instead kept as an attributed advantage sentence. Catalog's 32768-token max is consistent with Fireworks' listed ~32,800-token context. 01.AI's own GitHub repo (github.com/01-ai/Yi) does not list Yi-Large among its open-weight models, and 01.AI's current site promotes Yi-Lightning instead, so this write-up flags Yi-Large as likely superseded; a human should confirm current availability directly with 01.AI if possible. Verify pass: checked GitHub's news/changelog, Fireworks' metadata, Wikipedia's 01.AI article and 01.AI's own current pages for a Yi-Large release date; none state one, so the unsupported "launched in May 2024" claim was removed from the description rather than corrected.
